categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Touches compact block relay message handling and reconstruction in src/blockencodings.cpp and src/net_processing.cpp.
categories.rationale: Improves diagnostic logging and accounting metrics during compact block reconstruction without modifying protocol behavior or relay performance. The PR description notes it is split from #35558 to make it 'easier to observe compact block reconstruction performance' by tracking transaction sources and logging missing txids at trace level.
